verdict.rationale: Pika's developer platform says to "price a request before running it" and offers never-charged quote, balance and spend reads, so both pre-run cost visibility and post-run spend tracking exist. The evidence is a single passing mention scoped to the API, with catalog prices only implied. Nothing shows a cost preview or spend dashboard in the creative app a marketer would use. Missing for 10: documented per-generation cost display in the consumer app, a spend history or usage dashboard, details of the quote and spend endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see what a generation will cost in credits or dollars before running it, and track spend afterwards

citations.quote: Every generation runs against production at the price the catalog quotes, so price a request before running it.
the keyless public catalog plus never-charged quote/balance/spend reads
the playgrounds run the model with the caller's own key against production at catalog prices
